title: AWS Step Functions to AWS Lambda
description: Create an Step Functions state machine to call a VPC-enabled Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This CDK pattern generates an AWS Step Functions state machine which calls an AWS Lambda function deployed inside an AWS VPC. The Lambda Function is created with access to the VPC's private subnet.
